source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Gordon!

Thanks for following up. I just finished going through your article and you did a great job. Your writing is strong, but the blog can be made even better with a bit more storytelling – think engaging intros to break up long informational lists. My team and I added our feedback to the article for you to review and make relevant edits.

After you've had a chance to review and edit, we'll be all set to pass your test article along to our client. Your work is much appreciated on this, and am looking forward to your revised version.

Article with Fire&Spark feedback: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qoeAK7iJ0lgNA9-204BWbD4NZef54o6XKB4nTS11WNA/edit#heading=h.urzahnmktvtk>

Let me know if you have any questions!

Thanks,
Aliya

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Gordon,

Great news! Century Spring reviewed your work and wants to set up a time to meet with you. They'd like to learn more about your background and give you some context on their company and brand. Please let me know if you are available for a call this week.

The team also provided some feedback and edit suggestions on your test article that you can view here: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jTtblasgpeqKY31Tqyji9rMj48t3BcHGAQXeyBGtyfE/edit?usp=sharing>

Please let me know if you have any questions!

Aside from setting up this meeting, my team would like to assign you your next copywriting task. This time, instead of writing a blog article, you'll update copy for an existing landing page on <http://centuryspring.com|centuryspring.com>. I can send over the brief tomorrow. As far as your rates go, how many hours will you expect a copy editing project to take?

Thanks!

value_updates.task: Update copy for an existing Century Spring landing page

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Great! I'll pass along your available times and follow up with a Google Meets invite. What is the best email to send the invitation to?

The specific landing page you'll be updating is this one: <https://www.centuryspring.com/compression-springs>. As we did in the last brief, we'll provide specific instructions on what we'd like to see in each section.

As of now, we're expecting around 4 assignments per month. We expect blogs to take longer than copy-editing assignments so we may swap out 1 blog for 2 copy-editing tasks as needed.
